description: This file contains unit tests for the MediaPipeline component, specifically testing the data handling and event notification mechanisms within the Rialto client media pipeline. It includes mock setups, test scenarios for needData, haveData, and segment addition, as well as state transition tests related to media streaming.

classes.name: RialtoClientMediaPipelineDataTest
classes.description: A test fixture class inheriting from MediaPipelineTestBase, providing setup and teardown for media pipeline data tests, including mock objects, state management, and helper functions for simulating media segments and events.

methods.name: SetUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, creates media pipeline, sets default shared memory info, attaches source, and sets default playback state to playing.

methods.name: TearDown
methods.description: Cleans up the test environment, deletes frames, resets mocks, and destroys media pipeline.

methods.name: attachSource
methods.description: Attaches a media source with a specified source ID to the media pipeline, mocking IPC call.

methods.name: needDataGeneric
methods.description: Triggers a generic needData notification with current source ID, frame count, request ID, and shared memory info.

methods.name: addFrames
methods.description: Adds a specified number of media frames (audio or video) with given data to the pipeline, mocking frame creation and writing.

methods.name: deleteFrames
methods.description: Deletes all stored media frames to clean up resources.

methods.name: haveDataSuccess
methods.description: Simulates a successful haveData call, expecting correct number of frames and IPC response.

methods.name: createFrame
methods.description: Creates a media segment (audio/video/unknown) with specified data and timestamp.

methods.name: startAddSegmentThread
methods.description: Starts a thread to simulate adding a media segment asynchronously, used for testing concurrent behavior.
